public_gates: run additional near robust ablation seed blocks
run additional late robust ablation seed blocks
classify evidence as strong moderate or weak
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change actor input/output contract

hypothesis: A multi-seed expansion of the M454 corpus will reveal whether standalone recurrent-hidden or action-history sensitivity is genuinely sparse or only under-sampled in M452 seed block 9900.
success_criteria: additional benchmarks complete without sampling failure
combined corpus is exported with source and failure class summaries
documentation reports whether evidence is strong moderate or weak
next step is selected from self-ID gate expansion or task-family redesign
failure_criteria: aggregate success is treated as promotion evidence
